add.event: 肯尼斯·莱合并Houston Natural Gas与InterNorth组建安然
add.evidence: Enron was formed in 1985 by Kenneth Lay after merging Houston Natural Gas and InterNorth.

add.event: 安然宣布需重述1997—2000年财报以纠正会计违规
add.evidence: On October 16, 2001, Enron announced that restatements to its financial statements for years 1997 to 2000 were necessary to correct accounting violations.

add.event: 安然依美国破产法第11章申请破产
add.evidence: on December 2, 2001, Enron filed for bankruptcy under Chapter 11 of the United States Bankruptcy Code.

add.event: 莱与斯基林案陪审团作出裁决，斯基林被判28项中19项罪名成立
add.evidence: On May 25, 2006, the jury in the Lay and Skilling trial returned its verdicts. Skilling was convicted of 19 of 28 counts
